name: Camp Lagoonland
description_short: Weekly YMCA day camp for ages 5 to 10 based at the Berkeley Heights YMCA, with a daily swim at the Berkeley Heights Community outdoor pool, games, crafts and field trips. A Summit Area YMCA membership is required.

fees.name: Membership
fees.note: Summit Area YMCA youth membership (ages 0 to 12); a SAY family membership also counts

fees.name: Extended care (morning)
fees.note: Pre-Camp, 7 to 8:30 am; includes the morning bus where it applies

fees.name: Extended care (afternoon)
fees.note: Post Camp, 4 to 6:30 pm; includes the afternoon bus where it applies

fees.name: Extended day
fees.note: 8 am drop off and 4:30 pm pick up at the Berkeley Heights and Summit YMCAs

refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable; refunds less the deposit until April 1, 2026, and none after.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim at the Berkeley Heights Community outdoor pool except on trip days.
notes: Every camper needs an active Summit Area YMCA membership (youth membership $120 a year, teen $60 a month); there is no non-member rate. Pre-Camp 7 to 8:30 am ($95 a week) and Post Camp 4 to 6:30 pm ($110 a week) include the bus between the Summit or Berkeley Heights YMCA and the pool or reservation camps. Deposit $50 a week; refunds less the deposit before April 1, 2026, none after. Family members saved $10 a week before January 19. Camp 9 am to 4 pm.
